source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Models in the unit the bearer leads have **[Feel No Pain 6+](vsdata:core-ability/feel-no-pain)**, improved to **Feel No Pain 4+** for as long as the unit is **Battle-shocked**. Only an **ANCIENT** model may take it.

effects.while: the bearer is leading a unit

lastPrinted.note: Build 963, in force at this version's cutoff, no longer prints the Unforgiven Task Force Detachment; this rule is as build 946, the last to print it, gives it.
